body:
更新内容:

- 新增自动重试开关，可控制网络错误时是否自动重试
- 提升语音播放稳定性，并将默认播放速度移至常规设置
- 简化快速模型设置，支持配置思考级别，并统一用于标题和聊天建议
- 改进聊天附件、头像、背景及图片生成中的图片选择体验
- 修复 Google 模型同时使用多种工具时的异常，并改善部分服务的授权登录
- 网页和矢量图代码默认不再自动预览，减少意外渲染
- 修正聊天气泡透明度的百分比显示
- 移除不再可用的硅基流动余额查询

Updates:

- Added an option to control automatic retries after network errors
- Improved voice playback reliability and moved the default playback speed to general settings
- Simplified fast model settings, added thinking-level controls, and unified their use for titles and chat suggestions
- Improved image selection for chat attachments, avatars, backgrounds, and image generation
- Fixed issues when Google models use multiple types of tools together and improved sign-in compatibility for some services
- Disabled automatic previews for web and vector graphic code by default to prevent unexpected rendering
- Fixed percentage display for chat bubble opacity
- Removed the unavailable SiliconFlow balance lookup

name: Monica
body:
## 这次修改不多主要快点发包看看tg群的bot推送问题解决了没有

## 中文
### 简要
* 修复中文主密码在部分输入法中无法输入的问题（#118）。
* 修复卡包及快捷筛选排序体验和顺序持久化问题。
* 修复卡包拖动排序在残留 MDBX 数据库引用下可能闪退的问题。


### 详细
* 主密码、KeePass 数据库凭据和重新验证入口不再强制使用会关闭中文拼音组合输入的 Password 键盘变体，同时关闭自动纠错和自动大写，恢复中文及多语言主密码输入。
* 普通条目密码、Bitwarden 登录密码和加密导出密码继续使用密码键盘；多行密钥和格式敏感内容不改变原始换行与大小写。
* 修复卡包拖动排序后立即回弹、筛选状态排序冲突以及重启后顺序丢失的问题；排序会同步保存到本地数据库、MDBX、WebDAV 和 OneDrive 全量备份。
* 快捷筛选编辑模式改用与验证器一致的双列长按拖动网格，项目会自然避让，松手后只提交一次排序变更；同时隐藏仅用于兼容旧设置的空占位项，普通状态仍保留原有紧凑标签布局。

## English
### Summary
* Fixed Chinese master-password input failures with password keyboard variants (#118).
* Improved card-wallet and quick-filter reordering and persistence.
* Fixed a possible crash when card-wallet reordering encountered a stale MDBX database reference.
### Details
* Master-password, KeePass credential, and re-verification fields no longer force the password keyboard variant that disables Chinese IME composition on some keyboards. Autocorrect and automatic capitalization remain disabled while multilingual input is restored.
* Regular item passwords, Bitwarden login passwords, and encrypted export passwords retain password keyboards. Multiline keys and format-sensitive values preserve line breaks and case.
* Fixed card-wallet order snapping back, filtered reorder conflicts, and lost order after restart. Manual order is now preserved in local storage, MDBX, and WebDAV/OneDrive full backups.
* Quick-filter editing now uses the authenticator-style two-column long-press reorder grid with natural neighbor displacement and a single commit on release. Legacy empty placeholders are hidden while the normal compact chip layout remains unchanged.

name: oh-my-openagent
body:
# omo-ai v5.0.0-beta.30 (npm 5.0.0-0.beta.30)

This is a hotfix release. Steering a message into a running turn while the shared interactive host socket dropped used to lose the message and throw a raw "Error: Client not started". The underlying fix ships in the engine (senpi PR #1220): a typed RpcTransportGoneError, an onDisconnect notification, and reconnect-or-fallback orchestration. The TUI now degrades gracefully when the host connection goes away, and your steering message isn't lost.

## Engine (senpi v2026.8.30-3)
- rpc: session events survive a deferred rebind and are delivered once the client reattaches.
- pty and terminal: screen writes are serialized with a bounded backlog, queued writes and resizes are absorbed or merged cleanly, and replays no longer split or drop under trim and flush.
- compaction: a broad correctness pass covering deterministic fail-safe tool admission, preserved structured tool results and lane ownership, retry-safe reminders, and a shared admission cap for multipart results.
- models: context downswitches are admission-checked against the target usable budget, equal-budget provider switches work, and invalid selections roll back.

## omo-ai changes
No omo-side commits land in this release. It picks up the engine hotfix above, so upgrading is still recommended: the "Client not started" crash path affected the omo TUI directly.

- 修复打包应用通过 `file://` 加载时图标和样式资源路径不正确的问题，并删除不存在的 `/iconfont.css` 引用。

- Release 工作流新增打包 Electron UI 测试门禁，并优先使用仓库内的版本化 Release 文档，避免发布正文被自动生成内容覆盖。

---

### Cloud browsing and transfers

- Fixed folders with more than one API page being limited to the first page. Infinite scrolling and folder downloads now use the correct cursor, completion conditions, and deduplication behavior.
- Fixed 123 Cloud Drive folder downloads omitting items from subsequent pages.

- Aria2 connection notifications no longer expose the RPC secret.

name: iPhoneMirror
body:
# iPhoneMirror v1.8.1

v1.8.1 是面向 v1.8.0 的稳定性与可用性修复版本，重点改进蓝牙反向控制在多设备场景下的路由可靠性、快捷键体验和驱动安装恢复能力，同时完善无线投屏连接和正式发布校验。

## 蓝牙反向控制

- 每台镜像设备现在只绑定到明确匹配的蓝牙 HID 客户端。多个 iPhone/iPad 同时连接时，鼠标、键盘和系统快捷键不会再广播到其他设备。
- 首次为设备启用反向控制时会显示蓝牙客户端绑定窗口，可查看设备名称、地址和连接时间，并手动确认对应手机；之后切换镜像设备会自动沿用已保存的绑定。
- 绑定客户端断开后不会自动把控制权转移给另一台手机；客户端重新连接后恢复原绑定，避免误操作。可在设置中解除单个绑定或清除全部绑定。
- 蓝牙启停、设备切换、独立窗口关闭和会话结束均使用串行路由更新，并在切换期间释放鼠标、键盘和系统按键状态。
- 新增键盘快捷键设置窗口，可配置反向控制、控制中心、通知中心、主屏幕、App 切换器、Boss 键、程序坞和 Siri 等操作；支持冲突检测、恢复默认和取消绑定。
- 反向控制快捷键改为可配置的全局热键，配对提示会显示当前快捷键；Boss 键可隐藏或恢复主窗口及独立预览窗口。
- 改进 BLE GATT 回调异常处理、通知超时和断开恢复；鼠标移动在发送队列中合并并限速，保留完整移动距离，同时优先发送按键按下与释放事件。
- HID 报告地图加入 iOS 系统导航和 App 切换支持。由于报告格式发生变化，升级后需要在 iPhone/iPad 上忽略旧的 iPhoneMirror 配对并重新配对。

## 有线投屏与设备识别

- 横屏画面长时间没有有效帧率时允许后续独立的 QuickTime 快速重连尝试；视频恢复后会解除重连闸门，避免同一会话无法再次恢复。
- Apple USB 设备识别改用明确的 iPhone/iPad 产品 ID 清单，排除 Apple USB-C 音频适配器、Apple TV、Apple Watch 和 HomePod 等非镜像设备。
- 构建时从统一的产品 ID 配置生成 native、托管和驱动清理工具使用的清单，并在测试中校验三者一致。

## 驱动安装与清理

- 驱动安装器可以修复不匹配的 `libusb0.dll` 系统文件；替换过程使用备份、校验和回滚，失败时恢复原文件。
- 增加受保护的驱动清理入口，按物理 iPhone/iPad 设备分组显示设备节点和 Driver Store 驱动包，过滤 Bluetooth LE 节点并支持预览模式。
- 驱动清理脚本嵌入安装器并进行完整性校验，管理员边界由安装器负责，避免直接调用不受信任的脚本副本。

## 无线投屏与发布

- 安装程序自动维护无线 AirPlay 接收端的本地子网防火墙规则，覆盖 TCP `5001`、`7001`、`7100`、`8090` 和 UDP `1900`；卸载时删除专用规则。
- 用户指南补充无线连接失败、访客网络、VPN、AP 隔离和便携版手动防火墙配置说明。
- 正式发布包、便携 ZIP、SPDX SBOM 和 SHA-256 清单由 GitHub Windows 流程生成并逐项校验，发布清单同步更新到 `updates/releases.json`。

## 验证

- Windows x64 Release 应用与驱动安装器编译通过。
- 应用逻辑测试、WPF 运行时测试和驱动安装器测试通过。
- Native CTest 覆盖 USB 产品识别、视频快速重连闸门、协议和驱动配置恢复策略。
- 简体中文、香港繁体中文和英文资源通过本地化术语与占位符校验。

name: Bada
body:
## What's new

- **Incoming-transfer consent is now a bottom sheet that opens on its own** — the moment a transfer arrives, a translucent bottom sheet rises over whatever is on screen (in its own task, so the main app no longer gets pulled forward), with Accept / Decline, the PIN, and the file list. The notification becomes a plain banner whose tap opens the same sheet — no more Accept/Decline buttons clipped by OEM notification shades (vivo / OriginOS), and the completed-state photo blur now fills the sheet shape edge to edge (#279).
- **Name Card exchange, rewritten** — set up a personal contact card in Settings and exchange it Bada-to-Bada with an NFC tap (#251).
- **Instant button press feedback** — every frosted button now shows a pressed wash the moment you touch it, including the send sheet's Cancel/Done plate where the ripple was invisible over the backdrop blur (#278).

## Fixes

- Send picker peer names follow the DayNight theme instead of staying dark in night mode (#275).
- Bluetooth-to-Wi-Fi-Direct bandwidth upgrades are more robust: solicitation only at upgrade-loop entry while still on Bluetooth, an offer wait that scales with time since the entry request, and prior-channel teardown commitment tracked on both roles (#265, #266, #268).
- MdnsAdvertisementGate no longer floods the diagnostics log during peer sessions (#269).

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/kyujin-cho/Bada/compare/v20260814.01...v20260830.01

name: moys-asr-workflow
body:
## 下载哪个版本？

**默认下载 `MAW`** ： 它内置了我们需要的 `ffmpeg` 和 `ffprobe`，解压即用。
**如果你本机环境装有 `ffmpeg`** ： 可以选择体积更小的 `MAW-lite` 版本。

## 如何使用

1. 下载安装包后解压
2. 双击对应的 `MAW` 可执行文件，打开启动器
3. 在启动器中，可以执行字幕转写、生成工程等操作
4. 完成后，启动字幕编辑器，进行字幕精修

详细文档参阅：[完整使用文档](https://github.com/Moyf/moys-asr-workflow/blob/main/docs/WORKFLOW.md)
遇到问题可以参见：[常见问题](https://github.com/Moyf/moys-asr-workflow/blob/main/docs/FAQ.md)

## [1.5.0] - 2026-08-30

### 🚀 全新特性

- **纯文本编辑模式** ： 新增整体 / 逐条字幕文本编辑视图，支持直接新增、删除或移动换行并预览变更；会按文本内容尽量匹配字幕和字词时间码，支持拆分、合并、边界移动、自动估算及有效覆盖率 / 原始时间码复用率提示。两种视图保持同步，可切换显示已禁用字幕，编辑结果也会正确标记 dirty 状态。
- **动态图形字幕、文稿匹配与编辑器工作流** ： 增加 OGraf / Lottie 的预览、拖放与时间轴交互、字幕文字矢量字形导出、拆分后的列表滚动锚点保持，以及文稿匹配预览、匹配率统计、字幕句数变化提示和配置持久化。
- **批量转写** ： 可一次加入多个音频或视频文件，按顺序执行转写，并为每个文件生成独立的 SRT 与 `.mosp`。
- **表情包 OTIOZ 导出** ： 编辑器可将 `content.otio`、`version.txt` 和图片素材 `media/*` 打包为 zip，支持原始时间线与移除静音空隙后的时间线；非服务器模式下会提示不可用原因。

#### 实验性新特性

- **Premiere 交接工程导出（实验性）** ： 支持导出 Premiere 可用的 FCPXML 格式工程，可将字幕转成原生 GraphicAndType 字幕文本。
- **口播对齐（实验性）** ： 新增口播对齐工具，输入 `.mosp`、文稿与媒体后可把实际录制内容分为匹配、失败片段、不完整录制等类型，自动选取实际使用的片段。
- **OGraf / Lottie 动态图形（实验性）** ： 尝试增加动态图形的导出和预览功能。

### ✨ 提升

#### UI

- **Launcher 与编辑器布局细节优化** ： 各种布局优化，太多了不一一列举。优化了窄宽度情况下各个分区的顶部显示内容。
- **Launcher 多类路径输入拖放** ： 服务器媒体等路径输入均支持拖放，并复用统一目标路由与格式校验。
- **Launcher 与编辑器优化** ： Launcher 现可保存缩放设置、从产物菜单打开生成结果；编辑器改进字体与快捷键工具、表情包和工作区导航。
- **导出菜单分组以及文案调整** ： 导出菜单增加类别，优化了各类导出选项的分组和显示顺序。

#### 启动器功能

- **媒体工具与新建工程** ： Launcher 工具箱区分后处理与实用工具；空白编辑器支持拖入媒体或字幕新建工程并直接在浏览器保存。
- **生成波形功能** ： 在工具箱的「实用工具」中，可直接从媒体生成带内嵌波形的 `.mosp` 工程。
- **文稿匹配增强** ： Launcher 提供文稿选择与预览，改善标点处理并保留对齐边界；新增独立的 `mosp_match_text.py` 文稿匹配脚本。
- **固定处理与简繁转换** ： 支持按序批量替换和可配置分隔符，并可在本地转为简体、通用繁体、台湾繁体或香港繁体等，同时尽量保留可安全对应的字词时间码。

#### 编辑器功能

- **字幕颜色过滤** ： 编辑器支持按颜色过滤字幕段落，并批量编辑特定颜色的字幕。
- **可配置拆分移除符号** ： 可以自定义拆分时移除哪些符号（PR #76）。
- **空隙内字幕批量禁用** ： 在「空隙检测与调整」中可以批量禁用位于空隙内的字幕。
- **预览字幕颜色** ： 播放预览可按字幕的颜色快照给文字加下划线以区分不同颜色的字幕。
- **去空隙 OTIO 字幕标记** ： 导出 OTIO 时把启用字幕作为媒体 clip 的 marker 写入，支持继承颜色。

#### 编辑器操作

- **鼠标悬停画面预览** ： 编辑器新增波形悬停画面预览（默认关闭），并调整了视频预览区的设置布局。

name: Living_With_Sister-Monochrome_Fantasy-Android-Chinese_Localization
body:
## 版本更新
版本升级，从1.2.5升级到1.2.8。这回日本官方的改动不多但确保所有改动都是建立在原精翻&彩绘基础之上的。

下面是日本HBOX公司给出的更新日志：
- 2026-02-25 1.2.6 优化程序性能使其更流畅。
- 2026-04-21 1.2.7 新增推送通知功能。
- 2026-05-07 1.2.8 修复推送通知功能。

## 优化与修复
HBOX官方在1.2.6更新中将RMMV渲染模式改为webgl并且将帧率上限从20帧改为60帧，除此之外，我还进行了以下优化与改进：
- 在构建脚本中添加强制使用硬件加速
- 修复原本作弊键默认在屏幕中心，导致玩家容易误触的问题，并且对所有按键进行大规模改进，详见下文↓

## 新增功能
- 新增卧室妹妹立绘，从狐娘模组FFFox中移植了两个新的卧室妹妹立绘图，地毯倒立和和床上裹被的立绘图（后面会移植更多狐娘模组的内容。技术细节详见：[Commit be83f42](https://github.com/ArchiDreamZ/Living_With_Sister-Monochrome_Fantasy-Android-Chinese_Localization/commit/be83f420bbd264e39d640b1281fd13b1914ac52a)）
- 背景乐调整，将主菜单默认初始背景乐改为nekomimi，后续分别是Sunshine!、madoromu2、InstaVista、summer
- 更新主菜单背景，将原背景换为Daseson彩绘的背景并标注“+DLC”，为默认背景添加上下黑边，并且同步修改黑白与幽夜彩绘

## 虚拟按键与作弊相关
- 作弊调整，编写插件CheatMenuBack.js，为作弊功能实现可以返回上一级的功能，双指/虚拟按键“返回键”皆可。（这样点错了可以直接返回上一级，而不是需要像以前一样要一直选择一个作弊选项后才能退出。）
- 虚拟按键新增，添加“返回键”、“上”、“下”、“确认键”，并且绘制按键贴图与点击动画。
- 虚拟按键位置调整，调整所有按键位置与大小，所有按键调成一样大小。右侧按键整体向下移140并且向右靠边，作弊键放左侧屏内并设置y=280
- 虚拟按键新增，添加“按键控制键”，用于开关其他所有按键的显示，并且将原占用控制键的作弊键移到其他键位类别
- 虚拟按键设置不显示的场景，配置所有按键的“场景列表”，包括开场动画、主菜单、存读档界面。（这样游戏一开始的时候就不会显示按键了，就不会导致玩家在进入第一晚之前误触按键，技术细节详见：[Commit 7cae925](https://github.com/ArchiDreamZ/Living_With_Sister-Monochrome_Fantasy-Android-Chinese_Localization/commit/7cae92546566c3ff6442455e20ec61269488a44e)）
- 插件编辑，修改QJ_VirtualButton虚拟按键插件，将除了控制键以外所有按键设置为默认关闭，让玩家自己按控制键开启其他按键。（由于配置文件中无法改这个，因此只能直接改插件代码）

name: Mole
body:
Mole

Deep clean and optimize your Mac.

### Changelog 1. **Clean and Purge are faster without widening deletion scope**: independent scans now run concurrently, stray home-level artifact folders such as `node_modules` are no longer mistaken for projects, and live container cache trees stay protected. 2. **Safety probe cancellation now stops the whole cleanup**: if a live-cache or SQLite check times out or is interrupted, Mole preserves the current target, stops later cleanup sections, and returns the failure instead of continuing with partial evidence. 3. **Analyze and Status report fresher, clearer system state**: Analyze shows the local Time Machine snapshot count and explains why snapshot-only space is excluded from directory totals; Status adds zombie process diagnostics and retains the last process sample as stale when a refresh fails. 4. **Everyday edges are quieter and clearer**: CLT-only Macs no longer warn about a missing `simctl`, compressed menus keep the Space key hint, whitelist guidance accepts any path, and the `x/text` security update is included. ### 更新日志 1. **Clean 和 Purge 更快，但不会扩大删除范围**：互不依赖的扫描现在可以并发执行；用户目录下误放的 `node_modules` 等构建产物不会再被当成项目；正在使用的容器缓存目录也会继续受到保护。 2. **安全探测被取消时会停止整次清理**：如果活跃缓存或 SQLite 检查超时、被中断，Mole 会保留当前目标，停止后续清理阶段，并返回失败，不会依据不完整证据继续执行。 3. **Analyze 和 Status 展示的系统状态更及时、更清楚**：Analyze 会显示本地 Time Machine 快照数量，并说明为何目录统计不包含仅由快照占用的空间；Status 新增僵尸进程诊断，完整刷新失败时会保留上一份进程数据并标记为过期。 4. **日常使用中的细节更安静、更明确**：仅安装 Command Line Tools 的 Mac 不再提示缺少 `simctl`，紧凑菜单会保留 Space 键提示，白名单说明支持任意路径，同时包含 `x/text` 安全更新。 ### Thanks Issue reporters and PR contributors this cycle: @r266-tech · @M-Hassan-Raza · @anupamme · @devcsb · @TyceHerrman · @ilhanpaksoy · @mitchmalone · @grevgeny · @Veritas-7. ### Mole Mac App Prefer a GUI? -   **Tube Cleaner & Player Cleaner (`8a616f82`, #481)**
    Added optional remote userscripts that replace site players with native Safari video before first paint. Tube Cleaner targets YouTube; Player Cleaner targets other media sites. Restores Picture-in-Picture, background playback, chapters, captions, SponsorBlock skips, and optional DeArrow branding.     Added an optional Dark Reader install with an in-app appearance setting, so pages can follow a dark theme without a separate Safari extension.

body:
> [!WARNING]
> **The Repository Q&A Assistant is still in an early stage.** Please keep the following in mind before using it:
>
> - **Expect bad cases.** Retrieval may fail and answers may be wrong or incomplete. If an answer feels shallow, raise the **Task depth** setting at the bottom-left of the chat input (Default / Quick / Deep / Unlimited).
> - **The app does not index every file of the repository being asked about.** It is designed for simple questions and quick lookups (usage, docs, recent changes, small implementation details). For complex, whole-codebase analysis and multi-file reasoning, we recommend cloning the repository locally and using a mature coding agent of your choice.
> - **Function calling is disabled by default.** The experimental native tool loop must be enabled manually in **Settings → AI Configuration → Repository Q&A → Advanced Settings → "Tool-loop mode (experimental)"**, and it only takes effect on chat models marked as supporting tool calling.

> [!WARNING]
> **仓库问答助手仍处于早期阶段，使用前请注意以下几点：**
>
> - **请对 Bad case 保持宽容。** 检索可能失败，回答也可能出错或不完整。如果觉得回答不够深入，可以在聊天输入框左下角把「任务深度」调高（默认 / 快速 / 深入 / 不限）。
> - **本应用并不会索引被提问仓库的全部文件**，因此只适合简单的问题提问与信息检索（例如用法、文档、最近更新、小范围的实现细节）。如果需要进行复杂的代码分析与推理，建议把仓库克隆到本地，使用市面上成熟的 coding agent 来完成。
> - **Function calling（原生工具循环）默认是关闭的**，需要手动开启：进入「设置 → AI 配置 → 仓库问答 → 高级设置」，勾选「工具循环模式（实验性）」。该功能仅对勾选了「支持工具调用」的聊天模型生效。

name: bentopdf
body:
## Dad Joke Of the Release
What do you call a bee that can't make up its mind? A maybe 🤣

# The Biggest Release of BentoPDF yet!

**This is the biggest release of BentoPDF**. BentoPDF can now edit text, image, shapes in BentoPDF and there are two new engines **Kura** and **Hyper Compress**. Detailed Explanation is below.

## PDF Text Editing

BentoPDF can now edit the actual text inside a PDF.  You can click any paragraph and type. Text reflows live, fonts and styling are preserved, and everything runs entirely in your browser, as always.

* **Edit in place** with live reflow, real font matching, and word wrap that follows the original layout
* **Full styling**: bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, superscript, subscript, font family and size, text colour, outline colour and width, character and line spacing
* **Paragraph control**: left / centre / right / justify alignment, bulleted and numbered lists with indent levels, and left-to-right and right-to-left text
* **Find & replace** across the document, plus **spell-check** with a personal dictionary and per-language switching
* **Images**: add, replace in place, or export a PNG, edit it in any app, and have your saved changes re import automatically
* **Objects**: align, distribute, rotate, flip, duplicate, and reorder front to back. Even commercial software like Apryse and Nutrient do not support this
* **Accessibility**: alt text for tagged PDFs, and reading-order text export
* Undo / redo, document properties, page navigation, zoom presets

This was arguably the hardest feature I had built so far. Given the complex nature of PDFs and the different ways it can be produced, you might encounter certain bugs. 

### Note
Local fonts access is only available on chromium based browsers such as Chrome and Edge. Other browsers have a limitation of not having the font access API.

name: jellyfin-mpv-shim
body:
This pre-release is mostly polishing the app, the v3 series is slowing down
feature work and the rate of defects being logged has dropped. If you find a
show stopping bug, please log it asap!

The settings UI is now contains presets for more MPV settings and is searchable.
Game controller support is also added, it must be enabled via settings so it
doesn't grab game controllers when unexpected.

## Major Additions

- Game controllers now supported
  - Supports the same navigation as the Jellyfin Play On Navigation and keyboard.
  - For those bringing their own MPV (i.e. PyPI installs) controller support must be compiled into MPV, which is not the default in `mpv-build`.
- Better settings page
  - Added optional presets for deband, tone mapping, rendering, and network preload.
  - You can now search the settings page, making it faster to find a specific option.
  - If a setting needs a restart, it tells you and offers the option to restart.

## Improvements

- Trickplay is lazily fetched now, so no more 800MB temp files for long movies.
  - It also, due to an upstream MPV fix, stops breaking trickplay on HDR videos.
- JXL image decoding is supported if you install `pillow-jxl`. (Optional, #704)
- Windows has proper text rendering, previously it was falling back to basic rendering.
  - Notably this makes text sizing more reliable and allows RTL text display.
- Details pages now contain links to metadata providers.
- Navigating back to the home page is faster.
- Made application UI margins/spacing/phrasing more consistent.

## Bugs fixed from last release

- Fixed carousel buttons behaving oddly after back nav.
- Fixed mouse losing focus on some input devices or WMs. (#700)
- Fixed issue where MPV's console lost keybinds.
- Fixed jank when starting media causing library to flash.
- Fixed "Clear All" being broken in the filter panel.
- Fixed language filter set/reset issues.
- Fixed issue where pagination loses library sorts.

name: readest
body:
## Release Highlights
* Audiobooks: Added Audiobookshelf support for streaming audiobooks and podcasts, and you can now pair an audiobook with its ebook to read along as it plays
* Text-to-Speech: Added a lyric-style view that shows the sentences around the one being read, plus per-book offline voice downloads and steadier pauses between sentences
* Library: You can now browse the web inside Readest to add books, choose which chapters to import from a web novel, hide covers for privacy, and watch download progress right on the shelf
* Sharing: Added Nearby BookDrop to send and receive books between nearby devices over your local network, including KOReader devices
* Reading: Added customizable keyboard and mouse shortcuts, Yomitan dictionary support, a full-screen book cover view, and right-to-left page order for comics and fixed-layout books
* Reading: The Notebook is now a full writing workspace, where your notes save as you type, sync across devices, and link back to the passage they came from
* Footnotes: Footnote popups no longer get cut off, let you select and look up text, and can jump straight to the note's place in the book
* PDF: You can now select text across page boundaries, copy paragraphs without broken line breaks, and see the printed page numbers as reference pages
* Sync: Your book groups and shelves now sync, file sync between devices settles reliably, highlights you delete in KOReader come across, and your progress survives an OPDS re-download
* More: Fixed crashes on launch, garbled AZW3 books, the reading position drifting after rotating the screen, and unreadable highlights on e-ink screens

name: dxvk
body:
## Feature support
### DXGI incremental presentation
Added basic support for DXGI [present parameters](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/dxgi1_2/ns-dxgi1_2-dxgi_present_parameters). This fixes UI rendering issues in **VirtualDJ** (#5853), and is also used by various game launchers, such as Ubisoft Connect.

If supported by the driver, `VK_KHR_incremental_present` is leveraged to forward dirty rectangles to Vulkan, which *may* reduce the amount of work the compositor has to do, but is not guaranteed to do so.

### D3D11 buffer render targets
Implemented support for creating render target views on [buffers](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/d3d11/ns-d3d11-d3d11_buffer_rtv) directly. This is primarily used by various older Frostbite engine titles, including **Battlefield 3** where it fixes a long-standing issue with clouds misrendering in some situations (#5857).

**Note:** This feature is emulated by creating a 1D texture internally. It is *not* meant to be performant.

### Intel vendor extensions
Intel-specific extension libraries are now loaded when using an Intel GPU, which is a requirement for Proton to support Intel vendor extensions for D3D11 in the future. This will work similarly to AMDAGS and NVAPI extensions that are already supported.

## Bug fixes and Improvements
- Improved compatibility with some external overlays that hook specific DXGI entry points (PR #5846, PR #5851).
- Render areas in render passes are more aggressively optimized to the actual rendered image region on tiling GPUs.
- Fixed a D3D9 fog regression that broke rendering in **Mabinogi**, **The Witcher 1** and potentially other games. (#5804, #5808)
- Fixed a crash when applications try to compile shaders that can only work with D3D12.
- Worked around a specific type of out-of-memory crash on Nvidia GPUs with descriptor heaps enabled. (#5855)

name: Game-Save-Manager
body:
## Patch Update

### English
- Backup and restore tables now load dramatically faster
- Fixed an issue where registry save locations ending with a backslash were never detected
- Fixed the interface freezing during backup and restore
- Fixed games whose install folder names contain [ ] { } ( ) ! + @ | not appearing in the backup table, as those characters were being interpreted as wildcard patterns
- The backup table's time column now shows the newest save file modification time instead of the newest backup time, so you can see when a game was last played
- Registry save data is now counted in the backup size, so games that only save to the registry no longer show 0 B
- Renamed the size columns for clarity: "Save Size" on the backup table for the live save data, and "Backup Size" on the restore table for the stored backup
- Added sorting to the backup and restore tables — click any column header to toggle ascending and descending, with ties ordered alphabetically
- The row menu (⋯) now opens in its own floating window so it is no longer cut off at the edge of the app window
- Renamed the Placeholders Guide to Path Syntax Guide, which now also documents the wildcards (*, ?, **) available in custom entry paths
- Updated to Electron 44 from 31 along with all other dependencies

### 简体中文
- 备份和还原列表的加载速度大幅提升
- 修复了以反斜杠结尾的注册表存档位置无法被检测到的问题
- 修复了备份和还原过程中界面卡顿的问题
- 修复了安装文件夹名称中包含 [ ] { } ( ) ! + @ | 的游戏不显示在备份列表中的问题，这些字符此前会被当作通配符处理
- 备份列表的时间列现在显示存档文件的最新修改时间，而非最新备份时间，以便查看游戏的最近游玩时间
- 备份大小现在包含注册表存档数据，因此仅将存档保存在注册表中的游戏不再显示为 0 B
- 为使含义更清晰，重命名了大小列：备份列表中为“存档大小”（本地存档数据），还原列表中为“备份大小”（已存储的备份）
- 为备份和还原列表添加了排序功能——点击任意列标题可在升序与降序之间切换，数值相同时按字母顺序排列
- 行菜单（⋯）现在在独立的浮动窗口中打开，因此不会再被软件窗口边缘截断
- 将“占位符指南”重命名为“路径语法指南”，其中新增了自定义条目路径中可用的通配符（*、?、**）说明
- 将 Electron 从 31 升级至 44，并同步更新了其他所有依赖

name: cc-switch
body:
# CC Switch v3.20.1

> 这一版围绕 Codex 补两笔硬账：**适配 Codex CLI 0.149**——第三方切换 401「Missing API key」的根治：切换改为 config-only，密钥随供应商表走、不再进 `auth.json`，一族让 0.149 拒绝启动的历史配置形态也在每次切换时自动修复；**同一 ChatGPT Team workspace 的多个账号不再互相覆盖**——存量托管账号需逐个重新登录一次（见升级提醒）。数据可靠性另有三条硬修复：供应商编辑必达 live 配置、Codex 编辑框不再串染别张卡的密钥、恢复备份不再清空手写的 prompt 文件。用量侧新增「自动扫描会话记录」开关，大会话文件的扫描从秒级降到毫秒级。本版**包含数据库迁移（v17 → v18）**，升级前自动备份，降级需还原备份。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/v3.20.1/docs/release-notes/v3.20.1-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/v3.20.1/docs/release-notes/v3.20.1-ja.md)**

---

## 重点内容：你现在可以

- **在 Codex CLI ≥ 0.149 上正常切换第三方供应商**（[#6744](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/6744)）：0.149 起自定义 provider 不再从 `auth.json` 继承环境凭据，以旧默认方式（密钥只写 `auth.json`）完成的第三方切换一律 401。切换现已整体改为 config-only——密钥写进供应商自己的 `[model_providers.*]` 表（`experimental_bearer_token`，Codex 0.48 起支持），`auth.json` 回归纯粹的官方 ChatGPT 登录文件。
- **让同一 Team workspace 的多个 ChatGPT 账号安全共存**（[#6780](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/6780)，修复 [#2245](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/2245)）：此前账号以 workspace ID 为主键，同一 Team 两名成员会合并成一条记录、后登录者静默覆盖前者的令牌。现在同 workspace 登录并存为独立账号行，接管下的请求还会校验账号一致性——绝不把账单记到另一名成员头上。
- **相信「保存成功」四个字**（[#6779](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/6779)）：崩溃残留的接管备份行曾让活跃供应商的编辑只更新数据库、真正的配置文件纹丝不动。所有权判定已重建，编辑必达 live 配置。
- **在编辑框里看到这张卡自己的密钥**（[#6534](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/6534)，修复 [#6414](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/6414)）：共享的 `auth.json` 没有供应商身份，编辑活跃 Codex 供应商可能显示——保存后固化——另一张卡遗留的 key，同 base URL 的卡密钥互相趋同、报「model not found」。表单现在从 `config.toml` 里该卡自己的 bearer token 重建密钥。
- **放心恢复备份**（[#6810](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/6810)，修复 [#6778](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/6778)）：云端快照没有任何已启用 prompt 时，WebDAV/S3 下载或备份导入不再把本地手写的 `CLAUDE.md` / `AGENTS.md` / `GEMINI.md` / `SOUL.md` 清成空文件。
- **关掉后台会话扫描**：用量页新增「自动扫描会话记录」开关，关闭即手动模式——仅在点击「立即同步」时扫描本地会话记录；代理接管的请求记账实时落库、与会话文件无关，照常记录。

name: BS2PRO-Controller
body:
这是一个预发布版本（nightly-20260826），汇集了自上次正式版 v3.6.5 以来的所有改动；作为预览版，细节仍可能在后续版本中调整。  
This is a pre-release build (nightly-20260826) that includes all changes since the last formal release v3.6.5; as a preview, details may still change.

## 更新亮点 / Highlights

- 首页卡片可以自由排序，进场动画改为按行分组；灯带预览按固件真实行为重做，采用连续渐变并补上智能温控动画。 Home page cards can now be freely reordered with row-grouped entrance animations; the light strip preview was rebuilt around real firmware behavior, using continuous gradients and adding the smart thermal-control animation.
- 设备状态页新增固件版本、设备标识与更详细的状态信息。 The device status page now shows the firmware version, device identifier, and more detailed status information.
- 散热收益测试重新设计：按各转速测量实际散热效果，加入内存、存储与主板温度，并可将测量结果导出为纯文本。 The cooling benefit test is redesigned: it measures actual cooling at each speed, adds memory, storage, and board temperatures, and can export the results as plain text.
- 托盘提示与菜单新增 CPU/GPU 功耗显示；关于页新增开源声明。 The tray tooltip and menu now show CPU/GPU power, and the About page now includes open-source notices.

## 修复与改进 / Fixes and Improvements

- 修复蓝牙下的灯效传输问题，并减少固件闪存擦写次数。 Fixed Bluetooth light-effect transfer issues and reduced firmware flash writes.
- 品牌、设备与赞助图片改用 WebP 格式，加载更快。 Brand, device, and sponsor images now use WebP format for faster loading.
- 开机自启动注册更可靠，托盘图标异常后也能更稳定地恢复。 Autostart registration is more reliable, and the tray icon recovers more stably after issues.

name: moonlight-vplus
body: # Moonlight V+ 12.12.0 > **客厅大屏更顺手，HDR 体验再进一步。** 这次更新重点完善了 Android TV 与控制器的操作体验，并正式带来实验性的杜比视界（Dolby Vision）8.1 串流支持。 ## 🎮 TV 与控制器适配优化 - **TV 保留你的操作模式选择**：不再因为设备没有触摸屏，就自动覆盖已经保存的触控、鼠标或外接设备模式。 - **全新手柄 Start 长按轮盘**：串流中长按 Start，即可快速打开游戏菜单、键盘、性能信息和鼠标模式；同时重做视觉样式与触发逻辑，减少误触和按键冲突。 - **实验性 DualSense 蓝牙支持**：补充 DS5 蓝牙输入与输出链路，让更多客厅和无线使用场景能够脱离 USB 线缆。实际可用性仍取决于 Android 设备、蓝牙栈与系统权限。 - **控制器会话更稳定**：优化 USB 控制器在退出串流、重新连接和服务重启时的资源释放，并修复 DualSense 触觉输出的竞态问题。 - **游戏菜单更适合手柄操作**：操作模式恢复为单行显示，方向键焦点统一为左右导航；较窄屏幕和较大字体下也会自动适配，避免标签被截断。 ## 🌈 杜比视界 8.1 串流（实验性） ### 它对游戏串流意味着什么？ 这里的 Dolby Vision 重点在于：**让支持 DV 的客户端显示设备获得更好的 Tone Mapping（色调映射）效果**，更充分地利用电视或显示器的亮度与色彩能力。 它不同于影视内容中由创作者预先制作、用于表达内容意图的 Dolby Vision 工作流。该能力作用于串流与显示链路，**不要求游戏原生支持 Dolby Vision**；游戏无需提供专门的 DV 模式或 DV 元数据。 Moonlight V+ 现在具备完整的 Dolby Vision Profile 8.1 客户端链路： - 设备与显示能力探测 - RTSP 动态 HDR 协商 - HEVC Main10 + Dolby Vision RPU 信号传递 - Android 原生 `video/dolby-vision` 解码器路由 - 解码失败时自动回退到兼容的 HEVC / HDR10 路径 ### 开启方式 在支持 Dolby Vision 的设备上，进入“设置 → 启用 HDR → HDR 模式”，选择“Dolby Vision 8.1（实验性）”即可。 客户端会自动检测显示器与解码器能力、选择 HEVC、完成动态 HDR 协商，并在条件不满足时回退至 HDR10。配合支持动态 HDR 协商的新版 **Foundation Sunshine** 使用即可，无需再手动填写 `dolby_vision` 配置。 串流后可在性能信息中查看实际 HDR 格式；显示 `Dolby Vision` 即代表协商成功。 > **兼容性说明** > > - 主机端需要使用支持动态 HDR 协商的新版 Foundation Sunshine，但无需额外手动配置 Dolby Vision 开关。 > - 需要设备同时具备 Dolby Vision 解码器与支持 DV 的显示输出。 > - 部分手机厂商会限制第三方应用调用 Dolby Vision 显示映射；这类设备可能仍以 HDR10 / HDR10+ 呈现。Android TV 的开放情况通常更好，但仍以电视实际切换出的图像模式为准。 > - 当前仅支持兼容的 NVENC / AMD 硬件编码路径；不满足条件时会安全回退至 HDR10。 > - Dolby Vision 与画面补帧暂不同时启用，开启补帧时会回退至静态 HDR10。 ### ⚠️ 已知问题 部分手机与 Android TV 设备在特定的分辨率、帧率组合下，可能出现花屏或黑屏。这通常与设备的解码器及系统实现有关；如遇到问题，请尝试更换分辨率或帧率组合。 欢迎通过 [GitHub Issues](../../issues) 反馈，并尽量附上设备型号、系统版本、分辨率、帧率和视频编码格式，帮助我们进一步定位和改善兼容性。 ## ✨ 其他体验改进 - 默认精简分辨率列表，将 360p / 480p 收纳为可选的低带宽兼容预置，同时保留旧用

body:
### Quick Fix - *Actually* implemented the DirectStorage badge check. I messed it up in the last release and it never worked. Whoops. - The DirectStorage check now also uses the full folder tree in case developers hide the `dstorage.dll` file in other folders. Now that more games support DirectStorage, they aren't using standard folders anymore. This means that if you - for example - try to compress your entire Steam folder and it contains a DirectStorage game, you will get a warning. ----- ### Installation #### Binaries ````yml CompactGUI.exe (9MB): Smaller size, but requires .NET 10 Runtime to be installed CompactGUI.mono.exe (65MB): Fully self-contained and embeds the necessary .NET 10 libraries ```` #### WinGet ```ahk winget install CompactGUI ``` >[!NOTE] > Installing from `WinGet` automatically installs .NET 10 if required, however it can often take a few days for new releases to become available.

name: vorssaint-utils
body:
### Added
- General settings now include a Liquid Glass toggle on macOS 26 and later to control translucent glass visual effects across panels and controls.
- The video and GIF tools now include an option to compress directly to a target file size in megabytes, automatically deriving the resolution and frame rate to stay under the limit. Thanks to @FlowSync0.
- Shelf now shows real content thumbnails for dropped images and videos, covering more file types, and decodes saved image thumbnails asynchronously on launch. Thanks to @tenbux.
- The Command Bar now offers a compact mode where the bar opens as a field alone and shows results once you type, with Down arrow revealing the full list. Under Command Bar, off by default. Thanks to @kobebrylant.
- Command Bar script links can now be marked to run on their bare name without an argument, so scripts that work on the clipboard, selection, or files don't need a placeholder word typed after the name. Under Command Bar, off by default. Thanks to @rhukster.
- Monitor alerts can now warn you when the battery stays above a temperature you choose. Under Monitor alerts, off by default. Thanks to @ywu73.
- Radial Menu now supports custom profiles with distinct wheel layouts, color themes, shortcuts, mouse triggers and starter presets, and website links can fetch their actual website icons on demand.

### Changed
- Homebrew package rows can now be selected by clicking the unused space beside the name. Thanks to @pergioa.
- Clipboard history now displays image previews and thumbnails for image files copied from Finder in the quick panel, preview inspector and menu panel.
- Clipboard history now remembers whether you left the preview inspector open or closed across launches.
- New Scratchpad tabs now start at 1 instead of leaving the first tab unnumbered, while existing names stay unchanged. Thanks to @AB-boi and @JashRashne.
- Every screen capture tool now carries its own keyboard shortcut to open directly into screenshot, recordi

name: Twilight_Echo
body:
# Twilight Echo 1.1.0

**2026-08-26 · 基线 v1.0.5**

1.1.0 相对 1.0.5 累计 190 次提交、686 个文件变更。这一轮的做了：把界面材质与歌词
渲染做成完整的系统、把 Windows 侧的系统集成与音频引擎稳健性补齐、以及一次大规模的性能与
架构清理。

> [!IMPORTANT]
> 升级前建议备份设置与歌单（设置 → 备份与重置）。Windows 10/11 是唯一完成验证的平台。

---

## 亮点

### 液态玻璃材质系统

播放栏、卡片、歌词面板、侧边栏现在统一走一套"液态玻璃"表面材质，而不是各处零散的
`backdrop-filter`：

- 基于 SVG 位移贴图的**真折射**，边缘会按厚度弯曲背景内容，而非单纯模糊。
- **镜面高光**跟随指针移动，按压时有独立的形变反馈。
- **明暗自适应**：材质会根据背后实际内容的亮度调整透明度、饱和度与高光强度，不再出现浅色
  背景上糊成一团、深色背景上发白的情况。
- 设置 → 外观里提供完整调参（模糊半径、厚度、折射强度、高光、饱和度），也可以整体关闭回退
  到不透明表面。

### 歌词渲染重制

- **新增 AML/TTML 歌词支持**（Apple Music 风格的逐词 TTML）：逐词计时、对唱与和声声部
  （`x-bg` 背景声部按自己的时间区间独立进出）、翻译与音译分层。
- 逐行**弹簧动画 + WAAPI** 驱动的滚动与缩放，替换掉原先的逐帧 JS 布局写入；播放期不再有
  每帧 layout thrash。
- 歌词外观自定义器内嵌进 HiFi 侧边栏，支持外观预设、字体选择器（读取系统已安装字体族）、
  对齐方式与共享样式变量。
- 桌面歌词独立的字体设置。
- 歌词文件解码支持 **UTF-8 (含 BOM) / GBK / GB18030**，解码失败直接拒绝而不是产出 `U+FFFD`
  乱码；同一套解码器也用于外挂 LRC 懒加载与 SACD ISO 同名歌词扫描。

### 播放栏形态与可见性

- 新增**迷你胶囊形态**（无进度条）与紧凑扁平条表面，在播放页自动隐藏。
- 可见性建模为**三档设置**（常显 / 自动隐藏 / 完全隐藏），并按页面作用域分别生效。
- 歌曲列表右键菜单新增"下一首播放"与跳转歌手 / 专辑。
- 引导向导新增**播放器步骤**，首次启动即可配置播放栏形态与迷你播放器偏好。

### Windows 系统集成

- 新增 **SMTC 原生模块**（`audio-engine/smtc`，含 MSVC 工具链脚本与自检），系统媒体控件的
  曲目信息、封面与传输控制走原生实现。
- **任务栏缩略图按钮**（上一曲 / 播放暂停 / 下一曲）与图标生成。
- **全局快捷键可自定义绑定**，"上一曲"按钮行为可选重播当前曲或切上一曲。
- **窗口关闭行为可选**：直接退出 / 最小化到托盘 / 最小化为迷你播放器。
- 任务栏缩略图按钮可整体关闭；迷你播放器支持选择是否在任务栏显示。

### DSD 与音频输出

- DSD 播放改由**专用 ASIO 后端 / 设备**承载，与 PCM 输出路径解耦。
- 24-bit 源按**有效位数**判定直通：只有 24-in-32 的独占设备会走直通，其余不再无谓回落
  float32。
- DSP 主开关状态由各模块状态推导，音量以已保存值为准，避免启动时被临时状态顶掉。
- 均衡器编辑经共享 DSP store 实时生效，修复提交后不落盘的问题。

---

## 在线音乐与插件

**网易云音乐**

- 播放地址内存缓存加 **20 分钟 TTL**，过期自动重新解析。
- 播放后段**预取下一首地址**交给原生队列携带，过期即剥离重解析，切歌更快。
- 歌曲缓存命中走内存索引，去掉每次播放的整目录扫描；缓存改**流式落盘 + `.part` 原子改名**，
  目录带 LRU 容量上限。
- 上游请求出口加 **5 req/s 令牌桶限速**（时钟回拨时原地重置，不会挂死）；播放地址回退阶梯
  加步间退避，命中风控提示即时早停。
- 新解析会抢占旧的缓存下载，并延迟 30s 启动，连续切歌不再抢带宽。
- 歌单封面请求更高分辨率版本。
- 修复歌手页跳转：改用 provider 歌手 UID，同名歌手不再跳错。

**插件系统**

- 新增**插件开发者模式**与自定义下载目录。
-

## 🎉 **Release v0.9.2**

This is the final release of WinBoat 0.9, it only contains security patches and other minor fixes. Stay tuned for 1.0, we're excited to ship GPU acceleration and other cool things.

- Passwords are no longer logged in compose and FreeRDP logs (backported)

### 🛠️ Minor Changes:
- Bumped Electron to 44
- Bumped dockur/windows to 6.05
- The profile picture is now a local file (backported)

body:
# v2.0.1

这是一个针对长任务识图设置与诊断的补丁版本。

## 修复

- 修复 `visionTaskTimeoutMs` 在浏览器设置页与 Host schema 之间的校验漂移：客户端现在会在写入前正确检查范围和步进，避免 Host 拒绝后只留下 `readback-mismatch`。
- 明确区分“单次识图任务超时”和“首次识图后的整轮时间上限”；整轮限制继续沿用既有 wall-clock 语义。
- 保持 v2 默认 `visionTurnBudgetMs=0`（不限制）；不会自动迁移或清除用户已有的显式正数配置。
- 当整轮视觉时间上限耗尽时，guard 与日志会显示实际生效的限制；Diagnostics 与 Doctor 也会显示有效值及其来源，便于定位旧 profile / composition 覆盖。
- 增加针对设置边界、预算诊断、Doctor 输出和运行时结构不变量的回归测试。

## Compatibility

- No change to #220/#295 lazy activation or wall-clock accounting.
- No change to the v2 default: `visionTurnBudgetMs=0` remains unlimited.
- Existing explicit positive whole-turn limits remain honored.

## Commits

- Merge pull request #309 from ysr666/fix/release-v2-0-1-version-gate
- test: make release identity gate patch-version agnostic
- release: v2.0.1
- docs: add v2.0.1 release notes
- fix: harden vision timeout settings and budget diagnostics (#308)

name: QuickView
body:
# QuickView v6.46.0.6 Pre-release Notes

> **Changelog covering updates from v6.37.0.0 to v6.46.0.6: Introduction of In-Process AI Neural Super-Resolution Engine, AMD FSR 1.0 Integration, Objective RAW Color Decoding, and the Overhaul of the GeekWidgets UI Architecture.**

---

## Highlights

### 1. QVX 2.0 In-Process AI Neural Super-Resolution (#239)
QuickView introduces **QVX (QuickView eXtension) 2.0**, integrating the Tencent NCNN Vulkan neural network compute pipeline directly into the host process:
- **Direct GPU Memory Pipeline (0 Disk I/O)**: Eliminates external process spawning and temporary disk caching. Image frames flow seamlessly between Direct3D 11 Staging and Vulkan GPU memory via zero-copy in-memory streams (#239).
- **Omni-Lifecycle Auto-Trigger System**:
  - **Small Image Launch**: Automatically triggers debounced super-resolution when images are initially loaded at >100% scale (#239).
  - **Navigation**: Next/Previous page switches automatically trigger super-resolution once the base frame is ready (#239).
  - **Fullscreen & Maximization**: Viewport enlargement via `F11` or `Enter` automatically triggers resolution enhancement (#239).
  - **Window Resize**: Automatically activates super-resolution upon mouse release after dragging window borders (#239).
  - **Smooth Zooming**: Seamlessly triggers upscale as soon as the mouse wheel animation stabilizes (#239).
  - **View Mode Shortcuts**: Switching between Actual Size (`1`), Fit to Window (`2`), and Fill Window (`3`) automatically reconstructs the image (#239).
- **Full Animation Sequence Upscaling**: Multi-threaded pipeline upscaling for GIF, APNG, WebP, and AVIF animated formats, resuming high-definition playback seamlessly upon completion (#239).
- **Halo Seam-Elimination Matrix & VRAM Protection**: Seamless tile chunking algorithm eliminates grid artifacts across large upscaled images. Automatic interception for images exceeding 16 megapixels prevents GPU out-of-memory (OOM)

> [!NOTE]
> This release adds automated S3 backups, standalone container editing, batched container-update notifications, and GitOps redeployment for stopped projects.
> It also expands the CLI with commands for vulnerabilities, activities, and webhooks while improving project handling, OIDC support, and API behavior.

## Features

- Add automated S3 backups — `555c5dfbac478e7bbe336fff29cfe4d6277b2d6d` (#3459) (@affeldt28)
- Batch container-update notifications — `0239f62b45c7b2d485285a54fc54e44b6a0721e8` (#3650) (@wyx1818)
- Add the ability to edit standalone containers — `24894fc7310b747e95d2b5d59e0a5100bb8bf12f` (#3646) (@kmendell)
- Add renaming for unused volumes — `1e413ada2f2413fa2a7c97798288b73ddb9d6b6c` (#3704) (@neurekadev)
- Pull and redeploy images after GitOps sync for stopped projects — `f17e84412ae41dac1945f5b6896bafce8c244bb9` (#3698) (@ohOgil)
- Add CLI commands for the latest server features and adopt hyphen-free command naming — `d84511b8d67bef5fe3117832c9173ecc987e38da` (@kmendell)
- Add CLI commands for vulnerabilities, activities, and webhooks with end-to-end coverage — `f4f9df0e8f1373a9e7fcba145383fcda8b4b3fc2` (@kmendell)

## Fixes

- Ensure stable ordering for page walks without an explicit sort — `bf783a828ef816acf789851dffb2b8b8ed249450` (#3648) (@kmendell)
- Percent-decode API path parameters before use — `c469305cdacf49b80f7f5639f00eef597c1ca102` (#3682) (@kmendell)
- Show Git-synced project files as read-only instead of hiding them or crashing — `da21e2694754434d9b6b936834aed44173378ef1` (#3690) (@kmendell)
- Send the build directive for projects from the backend — `53017c67cf91656965d667bf23e80dc0b46bd482` (#3691) (@kmendell)
- Allow assigning roles to OIDC users and handle username collisions during OIDC login — `c38c2580fb14f8a8f15f74ef9203bfdb9896c466` (#3692) (@kmendell)
- Make the update-all dialog scroll correctly with large fleets — `b7a619b2c7f8f08f05cc78f3db51ac6aa63e9ef4` (@kmendell)
- Validate cgroup-derived container IDs du

body:
## What's New in v0.11.0

### ⭐ Favorites
Mark your go-to Homebrew packages as favorites and sort your list to keep them front and center.

### ⚡ Faster, smoother package list
The package table is now virtualized, so scrolling through hundreds of formulae/casks stays fast, search feels instant (debounced), and keyboard row navigation is more reliable.

### ♿ Better accessibility
Dialogs and modals now manage keyboard focus properly, so navigating WailBrew with a keyboard or screen reader is smoother throughout the app.

### 🧰 Small quality-of-life improvements
- Copying package info (like `brew info`) now shows a quick visual confirmation.
- Added a way to reset WailBrew's settings back to defaults.
- Session logs are easier to inspect, with clearer error reporting when something goes wrong.

### 🐛 Fixes
- Fixed package name detection for casks/formulae stored in newer "sharded" Homebrew paths.
- WailBrew now handles a broken Homebrew/Ruby installation more gracefully instead of failing silently.

name: oh-my-openagent
body:
## OMO 5.0.0-beta.18

**Safer worktree cleanup, current Senpi, and sturdier native sessions**

**Worktree cleanup is now a first-class command** - `omo worktree-sweep` finds
stale task worktrees, normalizes platform-specific paths, and applies the same
separator rules on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

**Review workers keep their checkout until every lane finishes** - parallel
review agents no longer lose the worktree while late lanes are still reading
or validating it.

**OmO Native now rides Senpi 2026.8.23** - the release carries the latest
session, runtime, and codemode fixes behind the beta channel.

This release also tightens OmO naming consistency and ignores both historical
debug-log filename casings during Senpi cleanup.

name: Scrapling
body:
**One of the biggest releases this year: a reworked MCP server, RAG-ready Markdown in one line, an improved Cloudflare solver, and browser tabs that stay open for automation 🚀**

> [!NOTE]
> **[Follow us on X for daily tips and tricks](https://x.com/Scrapling_dev)**

> [!WARNING]
> **This release introduces breaking changes to the MCP server. Check the [breaking changes](https://scrapling.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ai/mcp-server.html#breaking-changes) section before updating.**

## 🚀 New Stuff and quality of life changes

- **Browser tabs now stay open and get reused across requests** (Check the [docs](https://scrapling.readthedocs.io/en/latest/fetching/dynamic.html#session-management)):
    - All browser sessions keep their tabs after a request, and the next request reuses a free tab instead of opening a new one.
    - Every request re-applies its own settings (timeouts, headers, resource blocking) to the tab it gets, so nothing leaks between requests.
    - Tabs that hit an error are closed and replaced, and the new `close_pages()` method closes every open tab.
    - The page you fetched stays loaded, so a `page_setup` function on the next request runs on it before navigating away. That's the building block for chaining automation across requests.
- **Turn any page into clean, LLM-ready Markdown with `Response.markdown()`** (Check the [docs](https://scrapling.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ai/building-rag-systems.html)):
    ```python
    from scrapling.fetchers import Fetcher

    markdown = Fetcher.get("https://example.com").markdown(main_content_only=True)
    ```
    - Scripts, styles, and hidden prompt-injection content are always stripped first, the same as the cleaning the MCP server does.
    - Pass `css_selector` to convert only the elements you need.
    - Available through the new `rag` extra (`pip install "scrapling[rag]"`), which the `ai`/`shell`/`all` extras include too.
- **New `SiteToMarkdownSpider` template to crawl a whole website

> **Codewhale** is the public product from Shannon Labs. The `codewhale`
> command, npm package, and release-asset names remain lowercase technical
> identifiers. The legacy npm package `deepseek-tui` is deprecated and
> receives no further releases. Users coming from v0.8.x legacy `deepseek` /
> `deepseek-tui` names should migrate with `docs/REBRAND.md`.

## Install

### Recommended — npm (one command, both entrypoints)

```bash
npm install -g codewhale
```

The wrapper downloads the matched `codewhale` and `codew` command assets
from this Release. Both contain the same compiled runtime.

### Docker / GHCR

```bash
docker run --rm -it \
  -e DEEPSEEK_API_KEY="$DEEPSEEK_API_KEY" \
  -v codewhale-home:/home/codewhale/.codewhale \
  ghcr.io/hmbown/codewhale:v0.9.11
```

The image exposes the same runtime as both `codewhale` and `codew`. The
`latest` tag is also updated on release.

### Cargo (Linux / macOS)

```bash
cargo install codewhale-cli --locked
```

The Cargo package installs `codewhale`. Cargo cannot create a second command
alias from one binary target; users who want the shorter spelling can add a
`codew` symlink to that installed executable. The npm, Homebrew, archive,
shell-installer, and container channels install both command names directly.

name: GithubStarsManager
body:
## Highlights

Version 0.7.6 brings official GitHub-style README rendering, a unified design system built on shadcn/ui and Radix Primitives, and a batch of reliability fixes for release tracking and GitHub synchronization.

### README rendering

- **GitHub-style README rendering ([PR #287](https://github.com/AmintaCCCP/GithubStarsManager/pull/287))**: Repository cards (Repos and Trending) and release notes now render with the official `github-markdown-css` dual-theme styling. Support has been added for GitHub Alerts (`> [!NOTE]` and friends), gemoji short codes (`:tada:` becomes 🎉), math formulas via KaTeX, and Mermaid diagrams. KaTeX and Mermaid are lazily loaded so they do not affect startup or bundle budget. The table of contents, side-by-side translation overlay, and copy-code buttons all remain fully compatible.

### Unified user interface

- **Migration to shadcn/ui and Radix Primitives ([PR #284](https://github.com/AmintaCCCP/GithubStarsManager/pull/284))**: The presentation layer has been refactored onto the shadcn/ui component style backed by Radix Primitives. Previously the CSS and components were hand-rolled; this migration unifies the visual language across the app and lays the foundation for consistent, faster iteration going forward. The global theme now uses standard semantic variables (background, foreground, card, popover, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, border, input, ring, radius), shared controls such as Button, Badge, Input, Card, Select, Checkbox, Switch, Tabs, Dialog, and AlertDialog follow the canonical shadcn defaults, and dark-theme foreground colors on primary actions have been fixed. Business logic and data flow are unchanged, and an unused `react-router-dom` dependency was removed (production `npm audit` now reports zero vulnerabilities).

### Release tracking fixes

- **Correct release update times and asset markers ([PR #280](https://github.com/AmintaCCCP/GithubStarsManager/pull/280))**: The repository header now reflec

name: DeepSeek-Reasonix
body:
远程工作区：一台通过 SSH 连接的机器，其上的文件夹与会话像本地的一样出现在侧边栏。自 2.4.0 起 41 个提交。

## 破坏性变更

- **思考档位按 endpoint 判定，不再按模型名**。中转端点不再被提供厂商专属档位（`max`、`xhigh`）；超出该 API 文档词表的档位降级到最深的标准档，而不是被拒绝。声明了 `supported_efforts` 的端点仍以自己的声明为准。此前一个中转的 deepseek-v4-flash 每轮返回 `field ReasoningEffort invalid, should be one of: low, medium, high, xhigh, none`，且按继续会重发同一设置，该轮无法自行恢复。

## 新增

**远程工作区**（侧边栏 › 主机）

- 主机是一个分区而不是前缀：同一台机器上的所有工作区共享一条 SSH 连接，链接断开时整个分区一起变灰。本地工作区不带标记，所以带标记本身就是信号；同样的标记出现在 pane 标签与面包屑上，因为命令落在焦点标签指向的那台机器上。
- 连接后的主机列出自己有什么：其上的文件夹与其中的会话，通过已在该机器上打开的 pane 读取，不另开连接、不另起进程。恢复一个远程会话与恢复本地会话是同一个动作。未连接的主机只保留一行，这一行就是连接按钮。
- 每个 pane 在远端开自己的 runtime。此前两个 pane 打开同一个远程工作区会共用一份对话记录——一份记录，两个写入者，两条流交错。
- 冷启动会在远端安装内核，安装按步骤逐条显示，而不是一个分不清「正在下载」与「卡住了」的转圈。
- **主机簿可以在窗口里编辑**（设置 › 主机），此前只能从 CLI 添加。主机簿属于使用者本人，不属于添加时恰好打开的那个文件夹。`~/.ssh/config` 里已有、主机簿里还没有的别名，可一键导入。
- **首次连接会停下来发问**：不在 known_hosts 中的机器弹出指纹确认，带口令的私钥弹出口令输入。指纹换行显示而不省略中段——中段被省略的指纹无法与任何东西比对；焦点默认落在「取消」上。
- **Windows 可以作为远程主机**。此前 SSH 之下的一切都假设 POSIX shell，现在收敛到一个接口：用哪个 shell、路径怎么拼写、进程怎么启动与再找到。已对真实 Windows 主机端到端验证：安装、启动、跨 SSH 会话存活、经转发访问 `/status` 与 `/tree`、停止。
- SSH agent 在 Windows 上通过 OpenSSH 服务固定名字的命名管道使用；`IdentitiesOnly` 的筛选此前整个在 `!windows` 编译标签内，现在三平台共用。
- 主机密钥变更、指纹被拒、凭据被拒各自带编码，密钥变更携带 known_hosts 中冲突的那一条记录（精确到行）。不能承载内核的远端会说明是哪一半失败，而不是以 502 抵达窗口、暗示链路有问题。
- 远程会话列表与本地一样上限 30 条，主机可折叠。
- Windows 路径的两种拼写（SFTP 答复的 `/C:/Users/...` 与其内核接受的 `C:\Users\...`）由平台层转换。

**任务等待可以说明在等什么**

- `wait` 新增 `until_output_matches`（RE2 正则）：任务写出匹配内容时立即返回。一个跑一小时的任务因此只花一轮，而不是每看一眼一轮，并且仍会被真正重要的那一行唤醒。

## 性能

- **自动保存不再重扫已经读过的轮次**。每次保存都要遍历整份记录以生成侧栏预览行与用户轮次计数，其中两处模式是关于单轮长度的二次复杂度。

  | 消息数 | 之前 | 之后 |
  |---|---|---|
  | 1,000 | 70.0ms | 35.4ms |
  | 5,000 | 196.1ms | 119.3ms |
  | 20,000 | 652.3ms | 432.6ms |

- **工具描述减少 256 token**。三个最大的描述都以逐字段复述自己的 schema 结尾，其中一处复述已经与 schema 不一致。升级后各会话首次请求冷启动一次缓存，之后恢复。
- **只读的能力调用可以同批并行**。此前排除靠一张六个工具名的表，而这张表把「不需要审批」和「不能与别的调用同批」当成了同一个问题。现在每个工具自己声明，多个只读 `use_capability` 调用同批发出，而不是一个接一个。

## 修复

- **网关答 200 却什么都没送**——把流开着足够久以显得健康，然后不带任何内容结束——被当作模型给出了空答案：耗掉三次重试，

name: BS2PRO-Controller
body:
这是一次预览版更新（nightly-20260823），包含自上次正式版以来的多项改进；细节仍可能变化，请以正式版为准。  
This is a preview release (nightly-20260823) with improvements since the last stable release; details may still change before the final version.

## 更新亮点 / Highlights

- 重做智能温控灯效：灯带显示为连续渐变的流动效果，预览也更贴近真实设备表现。  
  Reworked the smart temperature light effect: the strip now uses a continuous flowing gradient, and the preview matches the real device more closely.

- 新增冷却收益测试：可按不同转速测量散热器实际降温效果，同时读取内存、硬盘和主板温度，并支持将结果导出为纯文本。  
  Added a cooling benefit test that measures the real cooling gain at each fan speed, also reads memory, storage and motherboard temperatures, and can export results as plain text.

- 托盘菜单新增 CPU 与 GPU 功耗显示；设备信息中可查看固件版本、设备标识和详细状态。  
  The tray menu now shows CPU and GPU power; device details now include firmware version, device identifier and detailed status.


## 修复与改进 / Fixes and Improvements

- 修复 0 RPM 后风扇无法重新启动的问题，并用设备确认代替固定等待，响应更可靠。  
  Fixed fans not restarting after 0 RPM and replaced fixed waits with device confirmation for more reliable responses.

- 挡位和自定义转速现在以设备确认为准后再保存，并会按设备能力限制可选最高挡位，避免设置不生效。  
  Gear and custom speed changes are now saved only after the device confirms them, and the selectable maximum gear is limited by device capability so settings always take effect.

- 修复重连时不必要的设备写入，并减少因瞬时写入失败引发的强制重连，连接更稳定。  
  Reduced unnecessary device writes during reconnection and fewer forced reconnects from temporary write failures make the connection more stable.

- 修复 Windows 托盘提示超出长度限制的问题，自启动注册也更可靠。  
  Fixed the Windows tray tooltip exceeding the length limit, and made autostart registration more reliable.

- 界面中的品牌、设备与赞助图片体积更小，加载更快。  
  Brand, device and sponsor images are smaller and load faster.

name: lnreader
body:
LNReader v2.1.3 focuses on the new stats screen, several reader and library stability fixes, and a handful of quality-of-life improvements.

#### ✨ New Features
- Add genre screen, charts, and normalization to the stats UI
- Add more novel status types and icons
- Create a dedicated custom code settings page (V2)
- Increase maximum text size limit in the Reader and Settings from 20 to 50

#### 🚀 Performance & Refactors
- Fix novel screen scroll lag, source pagination stalls, and skeleton overlap
- Space optimization improvements
- Refetch library after category updates

#### 🛠 Fixes
- Remove white flash during screen transitions
- Fix migration crash
- Fix stats screen logic issue
- Include all chapters beyond the 1000-row UI limit in backups
- TTS no longer continues playing during incoming/outgoing phone calls
- Pass plugin `imageRequestInit` headers to detail cover images
- Refresh empty chapters in the reader
- Upload JS source map

#### 📝 Docs
- Add `AGENTS.md` with agent setup, commands, and conventions
- Update translations

## New Contributors
* @aliomar139 made their first contribution in https://github.com/lnreader/lnreader/pull/1938
* @alvannoah made their first contribution in https://github.com/lnreader/lnreader/pull/1976

name: Bilibili-Evolved
body:
<details>
<summary>正式版用户将获得 v2.10.10-preview ~ v2.11.1-preview 的所有改动, 点击展开查看</summary>

✨新增
- 新增组件 `禁止直播可见性检测`, 阻止直播间在页面切到后台时自动降低画质, 避免切回前台恢复画质时卡顿. (#5556)
- 新增组件 `RBVP 视频策略`, 根据 UP 主、分区、标签、标题、时长等规则匹配视频, 自动执行倍速、合集记忆等动作; 规则支持异步校验、导入导出和别名编辑. (#5554, PR #5577, PR #5619, PR #5620 by [JLoeve](https://github.com/LonelySteve), [LainIO24](https://github.com/lainio24))
- 新增组件 `弹幕合并器`, 将其他 B 站视频的弹幕合并到当前播放页的画面和右侧列表, 支持关键词 / BV 号搜索、多 P 勾选、分 P 弹幕延迟顺延和播放进度对齐. (PR #5617 by [XianYuDaXian](https://github.com/XianYuDaXian))
- 新增组件 `视频快照`, 集中展示视频多个时间点的预览图, 也能从推荐、动态、空间投稿和收藏夹的视频卡片中打开快照; `下载视频` 还可将快照生成网格. (PR #5623 by [WakelessSloth56](https://github.com/WakelessSloth56), [LainIO24](https://github.com/lainio24), PR #5645 by [LainIO24](https://github.com/lainio24))
- 新增组件 `播放页自定义背景`, 为视频、番剧等播放页设置远程或本地背景图; 背景的不透明度、遮罩、模糊、缩放、位置和深色模式配色均可调整. (PR #5606 by [Andy_Allan](https://github.com/andya1lan))
- 新增组件 `直播弹幕助手 (+1 & 收藏)`, 在直播间增加弹幕 +1、弹幕收藏和收藏管理面板. (PR #5597 by [oooolcepsed](https://github.com/cccccccccooool))
- 新增组件 `直播首页暂停`, 阻止直播首页的推荐直播间自动播放. (PR #5610 by [YiJay99](https://github.com/YiJay99))
- 新增组件 `Hi-Res 音质按钮布局调整`, 将播放器的 Hi-Res 按钮简化为图标. (#5609, PR #5653 by [司城 ユヅキ](https://github.com/WhiteTeal55))
- 新增组件 `评论图片导出`, 汇总并批量下载评论区中的图片, 也支持单独导出某条评论里的图片. (PR #5661 by [塵埃殘憶](https://github.com/kaixinol))
- 新增组件 `楼中楼回复“UP主觉得很赞”显示`, 为楼中楼回复补充 UP 主点赞标识. (PR #5648 by [Light_Quanta](https://github.com/LightQuanta))
- `下载视频` 支持选择和下载 AI 原声翻译等多音轨, 并显示 DASH 视频的预计带宽和实际编码. (PR #5576 by [LainIO24](https://github.com/lainio24), PR #5660 by [EricZhou](https://github.com/EricZhou05))
- `视频预览放大` 支持解除 5 分钟预览限制, 并完善预览框尺寸限制. (PR #5664 by [wsgh0202](https://github.com/wsgh0202))
- `一键点亮直播间粉丝勋章` 改进勋章直播间识别, 支持导出和修改默认点赞次数. (PR #5612 by [k](https://github.com/kkkkkkkk566), PR #5634 by [司城 ユヅキ](https://github.com/WhiteTeal55))

</details>

🐛修复
- 修复 `自定义顶栏` 未隐藏原版频道下拉菜单的问题, 并排除 toy 与轻剪辑等不适用页面. (#5495, PR #5673 by [Lancy](https://github.com/lancy69), PR #5695 by [树根(佬?)](https://github.com/shugen002))
- 修复 `下载视频 - MPV 输出支持`

name: foundation-sunshine
body:
# DualSense 触觉进化，HDR 更准确，多客户端串流更稳定

本次更新重点完善了虚拟 DualSense、动态 HDR、虚拟显示器恢复与多客户端串流，也补齐了 Windows 中文及特殊字符路径支持。

> **系统要求：Windows 10 22H2 或更高版本。**
> 推荐大多数用户下载 `Sunshine.v2026.0823.WindowsInstaller.exe` 直接覆盖安装；Portable 版本仅建议有便携部署需求的用户使用。

**Sunshine 完全免费。如果你是通过第三方平台付费购买，请立即退款。**

觉得好用的话，欢迎给项目点一个 Star，开发者才不是很在意，只是会更有动力继续修掉杂鱼们遇到的问题。

## 本版亮点

### DualSense 模拟与触觉反馈

- Windows 新增可选的虚拟 DualSense（DS5）模拟，支持触摸板、运动传感器、自适应扳机与触觉反馈；既能向真实 DualSense 传输原始触觉音频，也能为其他设备提供传统震动回退。[#950](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/pull/950)
- 可在每个应用中分别选择 Xbox 360、DualShock 4 或 DualSense，退出应用后自动恢复全局设置。[#932](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/pull/932) [#989](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/pull/989)
- DualSense Sidecar 改为按需安装的独立组件，不再增加主安装包体积；组件安装、修复与升级流程同步加固。[#988](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/pull/988)
- 修复虚拟音频端点误设为系统默认、幽灵触点、Sidecar 恢复时手柄所有权丢失等问题，并改善《原神》等游戏的四声道触觉端点兼容性。[#991](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/pull/991)

> DualSense 模拟为可选实验功能，不会影响现有 Xbox 360 / DualShock 4 路径。目前主要验证环境为 Windows 11 24H2；其他受支持系统可使用，但建议保留默认手柄模式作为回退。

### HDR 与编码

- AMD AMF 编码路径新增 HDR10+ / HDR Vivid 动态元数据支持，进一步缩小 AMD 与 NVIDIA 编码路径的能力差异。[#939](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/pull/939)
- 客户端可上报峰值、最低和全屏亮度；VDD 可采用 Windows HDR Calibration 结果，物理显示器也可按客户端临时应用色彩配置，并在串流结束后自动恢复。[#948](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/pull/948)
- 修正 HDR10+、HDR Vivid 与 HLG 的序列化、归一化、启动预热和亮度抖动处理；恢复 AMF AV1 的低延迟队列默认值。
- 修复 NVENC 10-bit 4:4:4 CUDA array 输入的 pitch 问题，并将该路径改为显式启用，降低兼容性风险。

### 串流、显示器与输入

- 多个客户端现在可以同时向同一个虚拟麦克风输入，Sunshine 会在主机端完成混音；单个客户端暂停、恢复或退出不再影响其他会话。[#929](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/pull/929)
- 修复锁屏下多客户端黑屏、客户端断开后共享 UDP 接收停止、麦克风会话所有权异常等问题。
- 加固 RDP、锁屏与恢复串流时的虚拟显示器流程；手动选择物理显示器后不再被自动切回 VDD，捕获失败时也会寻找可用显示器回退。[#909](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/pull/909)
- 提高手写笔落笔采样质量并加入测试工具；VDD 驱动升级可直接收尾，无需重复安装。

### Windows、Web UI 与可靠性

- 安装目录或配置目录现在支持中文、空格及其他特殊字符，覆盖配置、日志、

name: J-Space-Cognition-Suite-V3.7
body:
# J-Space Cognition Suite V3.7.0

---

**EN** — The J-Space Cognition Suite V3.7 is a set of instructions a language model reads before it starts working. It teaches the model how to use its own inner workspace — the J-space — where thoughts form before, and often without, being said. This release adds the problem-model reference (incorporating the proposal and discussion from PR #11, opened by @lanting200 with commit contributions from @afeer123).

**中文** —— J-Space 认知套件 V3.7 是一套模型在开始干活之前读取的指令。它教模型如何使用自己本来就有的内部工作台（J-space）——想法在被说出来之前、而且常常是根本没被说出来——就已经在那里成形。本版本新增问题模型（problem-model）参考模块（吸收自 PR #11 的提案与讨论，由 @lanting200 发起，包含 @afeer123 的提交贡献）。

---

## Contents | 内容

```
J-Space-Cognition-Suite-V3.7/
├── .github/workflows/verify.yml    # three-platform integrity and regression checks
├── CITATION.cff                    # machine-readable citation metadata
├── CONTRIBUTING.md                 # contribution and provenance requirements
├── LICENSE                         # Apache License 2.0
├── README.md                       # English engineering guide
├── README.zh-CN.md                 # Chinese engineering guide
├── THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md          # attribution and license boundaries
├── tests/test_jspace.py            # standard-library controller regression tests
└── j-space/
    ├── SKILL.md                    # single entry, gate, routing, and invariants
    ├── modules/                    # nine selectively loaded protocols
    ├── references/                 # evidence, induction, problem-model, and exemplars
    └── scripts/
        ├── jspace.py               # optional loop controller
        ├── workspace-ledger.md     # ledger template and contract
        └── verify_suite.py         # authoring-time integrity check
```

---

## Highlights | 亮点

- Problem-model reference: settle the interpretation before acting
- Nine selectively loaded protocol modules + four supporting references
- Controller anchors checked against SKILL.md (issue #16 fix)
- Multilingua

name: Antigravity-Manager
body:
-   **[核心功能] OpenAI 兼容端点支持多模态音频输入 (OpenAI Audio Input Support)**:
    -   **支持标准音频格式与多来源映射**: 支持 OpenAI 官方 `input_audio`（Base64 编码 + 格式标识）及 `audio_url`，无缝转换为 Gemini 的 `inlineData` / `fileData` 格式。
    -   **多数据源与格式自动归一化**: 完整兼容 `data:` URL、`http(s)://` 远程链接、`file://` 本地文件及裸 Base64 编码，自动将 `wav`, `mp3`, `m4a`, `ogg`, `flac`, `aiff` 等格式归一化为标准 MIME 类型。
    -   **全链路与上下文 Token 评估**: 在 Responses API 转换及 `ContextManager` Token 估算中完整接入音频内容块，保障音频理解请求稳定交互。
    -   *相关 PR*: 详见 [PR #3321](https://github.com/lbjlaq/Antigravity-Manager/pull/3321)。
-   **[核心修复] 增强 OAuth Token 刷新平滑度与 invalid_grant 退避确认机制 (OAuth Token Refresh Resilience & Backoff)**:
    -   **提前平滑刷新 (5分钟缓冲)**: 将 Token 主动刷新时机由临界 90 秒扩充至 300 秒（提前 5 分钟），有效防范网络高延迟击穿与临界过期掉登录态。
    -   **原地退避确认 (Backoff Retry)**: OAuth 刷新层首次收到 `invalid_grant` 或中间层临时错误时自动执行 500ms 短暂退避并进行二次确认，杜绝代理节点抖动导致的误判。
    -   **连续失败门禁机制**: 引入连续失败计数器，仅在连续 2 次以上独立确认为 `invalid_grant` 时才执行账号停用，成功时自动重置计数，彻底解决偶发网络抖动导致账号误停用的问题。
-   **[核心修复] 修复 403 / VALIDATION_REQUIRED 识别时序与死代码，支持动态提取验证链接 (403 Validation Block & URL Parsing Fix)**:
    -   **执行时序重构**: 修复代理处理链中因重试策略提早 continue 导致 403 阻断处理逻辑被短路的缺陷，在遇到 403 阻断的瞬间即刻触发 `VALIDATION_REQUIRED` 判定与账号池剔除保护。
    -   **链接自动提取与 UI 状态同步**: 深度解析 Google RPC 响应中的 `validation_url` / `appeal_url` 验证链接并持久化至本地索引，实时触发前端事件刷新，为故障账号打上 403 标签并提供快捷验证跳转入口。
    -   **状态码精准回退**: 修正代理池账号全部轮换尝试完毕后一律写死 429 的问题，当上游为 403 / 401 权限问题时精准回传真实 HTTP 状态码。

body:
## NipaPlay v1.11.5 更新日志

### Bug 修复

**修复 iOS 网络设置中播放器 User-Agent 无法保存的问题** ([#871](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/871))

修复了 iOS 端网络设置中播放器 User-Agent 保存后不生效，以及关闭输入面板时控制器提前释放的问题。

**修复 Emby 剧集播放后详情窗口未关闭的问题** ([#873](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/873))

修复了从 Emby 剧集进入播放后，详情窗口仍停留在界面上的问题，恢复了正确的关闭时序。

**修复 Erika 内核与 JS 弹幕引擎冲突** ([#874](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/874))

修复了同时启用 Erika 内核与 JS 弹幕引擎时，弹幕未走 Erika 自带弹幕通道的问题。同时优化了移动端竖屏播放体验，修复卡顿掉帧现象，并使弹幕按比例缩放；此外为评论添加了单番剧卡片内的缓存，减少重复请求。

### 新功能与体验改进

**播放列表预加载与自动续播支持** ([#864](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/864))

视频载入后将异步预加载播放列表，为自动续播功能提供基础支持。同时优化了播放系统，新增远程垃圾回收机制以清理多余的 diff 补丁文件；移动端现已开放备份与恢复设置项。

### 维护与发布流程

- 更新了 README 及安装文档中的 AUR 相关说明：移除了已过时的 `nipaplay-reload-bin` 安全警告（包所有权已恢复），新增 Arch Linux AUR 安装入口（`yay -S nipaplay-reload-bin`），并补充了源码包安装说明。([#865](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/865), [#866](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/866), [#876](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/876))
- 修复了 README 中 Star 历史图表因上游服务失效导致无法显示的问题。([#868](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/868))
- 版本号升级至 1.11.5。

name: aliyunpan
body:
# BoxPlayer v5.0.23

## 中文

### AI 工作台与文档理解

- AI 工作台升级为更可靠的任务执行链路：文件检索、媒体获取与工作区操作会在主进程中统一编排，并保留可追溯的执行记录。
- 文档 AI 支持在文件预览中发起连续追问；回答可关联本次使用的来源，便于回看与核对。
- AI 搜索与会话状态同步优化，减少任务完成后界面状态不同步的问题。

### 媒体与刮削

- 优化视频媒体刮削：临时网络错误、限流和服务端错误会按退避策略重试，不再被误判为“未匹配”。
- 加强文件名清洗、识别诊断与未匹配分析；仅上报改善识别率所需的非敏感诊断信息。
- 统一外链、磁力、分享和字幕获取的执行流程，提升任务恢复和错误提示的一致性。

### 网盘与上传

- 修复拖拽上传到非阿里云盘子目录时，因目录 ID 格式校验而被拒绝的问题。
- 修复 Dropbox 子目录上传丢失目标路径上下文的问题；文件和文件夹任务均会保存目标目录信息。
- 强化百度网盘上传目标路径解析，避免拖拽后因页面状态变化而上传到错误位置。
- 改善多个网盘的列表/文件模型兼容性与上传任务持久化。

### 稳定性与分析

- 修复应用启动时分析服务初始化时机，确保错误与使用事件能够正常发送。
- 增加媒体扫描、AI 刮削和上传目标的回归测试。

## English

### AI Workspace and document insights

- The AI Workspace now uses a more reliable task execution pipeline. File search, media acquisition, and workspace actions are orchestrated in the main process with an auditable execution history.
- Document AI supports follow-up questions from file preview, with source-aware responses for easier review.
- Improved AI Search and session state synchronization after task completion.

### Media and metadata matching

- Video matching now retries transient network, rate-limit, and server failures with backoff instead of incorrectly marking them as unmatched.
- Improved filename normalization, diagnostics, and unmatched-media analysis using only the non-sensitive data required to improve recognition.
- Unified the execution flow for external URLs, magnets, shares, and subtitles for more consistent recovery and error reporting.

### Cloud drives and uploads

- Fixed drag-and-drop uploads being rejected in non-Aliyun subfolders because of an Aliyun-specific folder-ID validation rule.
- Fixed Dropbox subfolder uploads losing their destination-path context; both file and folder tasks now retain the target folder information.
- Hardened Baidu upload destination resolution so drag uploads cannot be redirected by later UI state changes.
- Improved cross-provider file-list compatibility and upload-task persistence.

name: moonlight-vplus
body:
# 🌙 Moonlight V+ 12.11.9

## 🇬🇧 English

Thank you for using Moonlight V+! If you like the project, consider leaving a ⭐.

This release is led by an end-to-end DualSense haptics pipeline. With a wired DS5 and the V+ USB driver, Moonlight V+ now supports native haptics, adaptive triggers, touchpad input, battery reporting, and lightbar control.

Our view is that streaming is most often enjoyed on portable devices paired with different controller models and hardware variants, rather than in one fixed desktop setup. That is why simulated haptics also matter: when direct DS5 PCM output is unavailable, coordinated controller and device vibration should still feel synchronized and close to native feedback.

### DualSense Haptics, End to End

- **Native DS5 haptics over USB**: Compatible 48 kHz stereo PCM haptics can travel from the host, through the Moonlight streaming protocol and Android USB stack, directly to the DualSense voice-coil actuators. This is true DualSense haptics rather than a basic rumble conversion.
- **Near-native simulated feedback**: Controller rumble and Android-device vibration can respond to the same game event, providing fuller feedback when direct PCM haptics are unavailable.
- **Adaptive triggers**: A wired DualSense claimed by the V+ USB driver can receive left and right trigger effects from a compatible host.
- **Three rumble modes**: Choose Coordinated, Device, or Controller output to match your setup. Existing vibration preferences are migrated automatically.
- **Reliable haptic routing**: Game rumble, audio haptics, touch feedback, and menu feedback share a central dispatcher with bounded background processing, rate limiting, session isolation, and safe timeouts. Slow vendor vibration services no longer block the streaming UI.

Native PCM haptics and adaptive triggers require a wired DualSense claimed by the V+ USB driver and a compatible host implementation. Support may vary depending on the Android device and USB stack.

name: Mole
body:
Mole

Deep clean and optimize your Mac.

### Changelog 1. **Uninstall keeps shared developer state safe**: app names can no longer turn `~/.local`, `~/.config`, or `~/.cache` into leftovers, and the final delete path protects those roots too. 2. **Autodesk Fusion cleanup reclaims old app bundles**: `mo clean` removes only verified older Fusion bundles, keeps the current and newer versions, and pauses when Fusion or its updater may be active. 3. **Orphan service cleanup keeps working helpers online**: Mole no longer unloads a registration before a refused removal, and it preserves standalone helper apps and helpers still referenced by a surviving plist. 4. **Stale SQLite sidecars no longer block cleanup**: an idle `-shm` file left after a crash no longer looks like a live database, while live or inconclusive database families stay protected. 5. **Installation and command guidance are clearer**: the README now uses real command output, documents the no-admin `~/.local/bin` path, and explains that the legacy `latest` token installs unreleased `main` code. ### 更新日志 1. **卸载会保护共享的开发工具数据**：应用名称不会再把 `~/.local`、`~/.config` 或 `~/.cache` 识别成残留，最终删除入口也会保护这些根目录。 2. **Autodesk Fusion 清理可以释放旧版本空间**：`mo clean` 只会删除经过确认的旧版 Fusion 应用包，当前版本和更新版本都会保留，Fusion 或更新程序可能仍在运行时也会暂停清理。 3. **孤立服务清理不会再让正常的辅助程序离线**：删除被拒绝前不会卸载注册，独立辅助应用和仍被现有 plist 引用的辅助程序也会保留。 4. **残留的 SQLite 边车文件不会再阻止清理**：异常退出留下的空闲 `-shm` 文件不会再被当成正在使用的数据库，确实活跃或无法确认的数据库组仍会受到保护。 5. **安装和命令说明更清楚**：README 换成了真实命令输出，补充了无需管理员权限的 `~/.local/bin` 安装方式，也说明旧的 `latest` 参数实际会安装尚未发布的 `main` 代码。 ### Thanks Issue reporters and PR contributors this cycle: @ennioVisco · @andynormancx · @Frankw618 · @buiducnhat · @tommyent · @nathankim0. ### Mole Mac App Prefer a GUI? name: shairport-sync
body:
### Version 5.2.2
This update contains enhancements  and bug fixes and is recommended for all users.

### Enhancement
* If the output rate is different to the input rate (e.g. 48,000 vs 44,100), the deepest output bit depth will be chosen so that the transcoder has the maximum dynamic range available to minimise transcoding inaccuracies.
### Bug Fixes
* Fixed a bug whereby the audio backend latency offset was mishandled in AirPlay 2 operation.

  Background: the `audio_backend_latency_offset_in_seconds` in the `general` section of the configuration file allows you to [delay or advance the output](ADVANCED%20TOPICS/AdjustingSync.md#adjusting-synchronisation-with-shairport-sync) by a fixed amount relative to the exact synchronisation time. It can be used, for example, to delay the audio slightly so that it synchronises with audio coming from another device that is delayed by internal processing.

  The bug was that the latency offset value was being used before the frame rate of the incoming audio was properly set, resulting in an incorrect calculation of the number of frames to offset.

  Many thanks to [prhodey](https://github.com/prhodey) for discovering and investigating the problem and for a [PR](https://github.com/mikebrady/shairport-sync/pull/2253) that fixes the problem for Buffered Audio streams. An adjustment has also been made to the treatment of Realtime streams.

* Fixed a subtle output format selection bug thanks to [nicolas314](https://github.com/nicolas314)'s [report](https://github.com/mikebrady/shairport-sync/issues/2244).

  The bug would occur only in specific circumstances when searching for a suitable output rate and format to match the input. Rather ironically, it arose from an attempt to maximise audio fidelity, as follows:

name: alt-sendme
body:
Find devices on your own Wi-Fi and send to them without typing a code, keep a record of what you've transferred, and stay reachable while the app is in the background. This release folds in everything from the 0.6.9 pre-release.

## Highlights

**Nearby - local discovery** (#190, #287)
DashBeam finds other devices on your Wi-Fi/LAN over mDNS. Confirm with a short fingerprint, then send files or pair without typing a code. Once paired, you stay connected even after you leave that network. Control who can see you under Settings → Network (Everyone / Paired only / Off).

**Transfer history** (#296)
A record of what you've sent and received.

**QR codes** (#252)
Show a QR when sending, and open a QR for receive links, so the other device can scan instead of copying text.

**Notifications**
Desktop and Android notify you for pair requests and file invites. Banners stay quiet while the app is in the foreground. Turn them off in Settings.

**Tray and background presence** (#286)
Close to the tray, start at login, and see which paired devices are online from the menu bar (macOS) or system tray (Windows). Android runs a background presence service so it stays reachable with the app closed. Flatpak uses the desktop background portal for autostart.

**Pairing polish**
Verification codes appear in pairing dialogs, unpairing recovers if a Forget notification was missed, you're offered start-at-login after pairing your first device, and removing a device now shows progress instead of appearing to hang.

## Fixes

- Long-standing PC↔Android send failures and mid-transfer "peer went offline" drops (#240, #274)
- Paired control connections timing out after ~30s, and concurrent sessions marking a live peer Offline (#279)
- Nearby: accepting an invite no longer unpairs both devices; declined requests, device names, and mDNS rediscovery are handled correctly
- Android: exports land in Download/DashBeam and open from the app

## New contributors

@SuperCoo

name: whatcable
body:
# Notifications behave, thanks to a proper bug report

**Unplugging a dock posts one notification, not a lottery.** macOS reports a
hub and the devices behind it leaving as a dribble of separate events, and
WhatCable notified on whatever slice happened to arrive together, so what got
named varied run to run. Changes now settle for about a second and a half,
then get grouped under the hub they belong to: one notification titled with
the dock, everything that left with it listed inside, each device on its own
row. Same on connect, at the cost of that small delay. Thanks to
@official-Cromatin for the methodical report and the raw captures (#551), the
test data for this fix is built from them.

**"Notify on app updates" stands on its own.** It was nested under the
cable-changes toggle, so turning cable notifications off silently took update
notifications with it. It is now its own switch, either can be on without the
other. Also @official-Cromatin (#550).

The test-kit probes also cast a wider net: they now match base IOKit classes
instead of a fixed list of leaf names, so port-controller variants Apple ships
next turn up in diagnostics instead of being invisible.

The one to lean on: plug and unplug a dock with things behind it and see if
the notification names the lot.

body: ### 遇到 BUG 或不清楚的功能，欢迎到 [GitHub](https://github.com/Pixeval/Pixeval/issues) 仓库的 issue 中搜索、提问，绝大部分问题都可以在一两天内得到解决 Pixeval 5.0.0 使用 Avalonia 重写，现支持 Windows/MacOS/Linux/Android 平台 （由于界面按照宽屏设计，Android 仅建议在宽屏的 Android Pad 上使用）。 ## 下载 对于 Windows 用户：仍然可以在微软商店下载更新，但更建议直接安装下方的 exe 版本或底部的 ZIP 打包版（不是绿色版，支持自动更新） [](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/Pixeval/9p1rzl9z8454?launch=true&mode=mini) ### 如何从下方选择自己需要的进行下载？ * Windows 用户：选择 *.exe 后缀名的文件进行下载并安装使用，或者相应 *.zip 后缀名的便携版下载后直接解压使用 * MacOS 用户：选择 *.pkg 后缀名的文件进行下载并安装使用，或者相应 *.zip 后缀名的便携版下载后直接解压使用 * Linux 用户：选择 *.AppImage 后缀名的文件下载后直接运行即可 * Android 用户：选择 *.apk 后缀名的文件进行下载并安装使用 * *.json 文件是供 Pixeval 自动更新使用的标志文件，无需手动下载 * *.nupkg 文件是 Pixeval 自动更新时候下载的软件本体，无需手动下载 * SHA256SUMS.txt 是发布文件 SHA256 校验码，无需下载 ## 较 WinUI3 版本更新内容 - 更流畅、立即响应的 UI 和使用体验，更少崩溃错误 - 更完整的 Pixiv API（例如系列作品、高级搜索参数等） - 内存泄露修复（关闭页面后一段时间，或强制回收后内存可以回到打开页面前水平） - 稍后再看：不用点开或收藏图片，下次也能方便找到之前想看的作品 - 订阅下载：每次打开 Pixeval，自动例行获取最新指定列表作品，并下载 - 自动播放：指定每 N 秒自动切换到下一张图，解放双手 - 连续看图：将图集所有图片同时显示在屏幕中，免去翻页的麻烦 - 跨会话缓存：关闭软件后图片缓存依旧保留在磁盘上，不用下载也能快速回看图片 - 卡片式主页：自定义你最关注的列表并在主页突出显示 - 开启 MCP 服务器：让 AI 调用 Pixeval 功能帮你收集分析作品 - 更多下载宏，下载宏支持格式化符号，更高度自定义下载路径 - 筛选语句提示：不用再打开帮助页对照 - 自定义的导航栏：可以关闭或折叠你不需要的功能，把你需要的功能放在最方便的位置 - 更模块化的功能：WebP、PDF 格式下载移动到扩展功能，WinUI3 已有的扩展仍然支持（但需更新版本） - 开发自己的扩展：不一定需要C#，如果你会 C++/Python 等语言，你也可以[在这开发](https://github.com/Pixeval/Pixeval.Extensions)自己需要的扩展 ## 扩展 仍提供 WinUI3 相同功能的扩展（且WebP、PDF 下载格式拆成了扩展），但由于支持跨平台，不同架构扩展过多所以不列在当前 Release 中，请到对应仓库的 Release 中下载对应平台和架构的扩展： - [Pixeval.Extensions.Formats](https://github.com/Pixeval/Pixeval.Extensions.Formats)：Pixeval 下载格式扩展插件 - [Pixeval.Extensions.ImageTransformers](https://github.com/Pixeval/Pixeval.Extensions.ImageTransformers)：Pixeval AI提升画质插件 - [Pixeval.Extensions.Translators](https://github.com/Pixeval/Pixeval.Extensions.Translators)：Pixeval 翻译器插件 - [Pixeval.Extensions.Downloaders](https://github.com/Pixeval/

body:
## Fixed

- Persisted the final model-visible image evidence across DSH Profile restarts, so historical images no longer consume vision quota again or change the main model’s cached conversation prefix.
- Preserved both successful descriptions and `[vision unavailable: ...]` results byte-for-byte; only requests that fail before producing any model-visible result are retried.
- Bound persisted evidence to the Session lifecycle, attachment, focus prompt, credential, and output-affecting runtime settings to prevent replay across incompatible configurations.

name: desktop
body:
# Zen Stable Release


## Security
- https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/mfsa2026-74/

## New Features
- Update Firefox version to 154.0
- Local Zen profile backups are now available on macOS in addition to Windows and Linux, and backups can be restored across all three platforms.
- Sites can now be exempted from having their cookies and site data cleared on shutdown without also being exempted from tracking protection and other cookie restrictions.
- The full-page Translations feature now translates <iframe> content.
- The full-page Translations feature now runs language identification on all page loads, resulting in an improved experience for offering translations to users.
- Performing a hard reload on a page (holding Shift while clicking the Refresh button) now also clears and updates its cached favicons.

## Fixes
- Improved battery life on MacOS when using vibrancy effects
- Improved performance of session restore, having spikes of CPU usage every time the session is stored into disk ([#14990](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/14990))
- Fix multiple glance tabs when joining tabs ([#14975](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/14975))
- Improved rendering performance on MacOS and memory leaks when using WebRTC ([#9649](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/9649))
- Fixed an issue on macOS where closing a browser window could leave behind an invisible window that continued to capture mouse clicks over the area where it used to be.
- Fixed an issue on Windows where an auto-hiding taskbar would not appear until the Zen window had been minimized and restored after launch.
- Fixed an issue where the Windows taskbar would appear in front of a full screen Picture-in-Picture window.
- Fixed PDF documents not being scaled correctly in print preview when the Fit to Page Width option is used.
- Other bug fixes and improvements.

## Known Issues
- Following recent changes to Zen's password storage, some users may experience slower

- 优化下载任务的查询性能，任务数量较多时不再读取全部记录
- 媒体信息优先获取链接指向的视频，不再固定使用解析结果中的第一个视频
- 获取媒体信息失败时自动改用其他视频，充电专属等无权限视频不再导致整个解析结果无法下载
- 提升内置 FFmpeg 转换 MP3 时的性能

### 修复
- 修复 MP4 容器合并后丢失杜比视界元数据信息的问题
- 修复 macOS 26 窗口激活异常问题
- 修复 MCP 查询任务状态时，只下载音频或文件重名的任务返回的文件路径不正确的问题
- 修复 FFmpeg 处理失败后，其余等待合并的任务一直停在「等待 FFmpeg 处理中」的问题
- 修复启用「将 M4A 转换为 MP3」的任务在转换中断后无法重试的问题
> [!CAUTION]
> 强烈建议仅通过官方 GitHub 链接（即本页面下方的链接）下载本软件。 从第三方网站、网盘论坛或他人私下分享渠道获取的安装包，极有可能被二次篡改或植入病毒/木马。对于因下载、运行非官方渠道安装包所导致的任何设备损坏、隐私泄露或财产损失，开发者概不负责。

## What's Changed

This beta introduces a complete reduced-motion preference, simplifies task interaction feedback, and fixes transition lifecycle freezes when motion is reduced.

### ✨ New Features

- **Reduce motion preference** — Added a new option under **Settings → General → Appearance**. Animations remain enabled by default.
- **Unified motion control** — Reduced Vue, Naive UI, AutoAnimate, list, and drag motion through one application-wide preference.

### 🛠 Improvements

- Removed unnecessary task button press animations for faster interaction feedback.
- Kept task sorting and list updates responsive when reduced motion is enabled.

- Fixed task cards failing to appear after adding downloads with reduced motion enabled.

name: cc-switch
body:
# CC Switch v3.20.0

> 这一版由三条结构性主线撑起：**Pi 成为第九个受管应用**——供应商、提示词、Skills、会话浏览与用量统计一站接入；**Codex 支持多个 ChatGPT 账号**——认证中心随便登几个，每张官方卡各绑各的，切换永不串账；**Claude Code 内置 WebSearch 在 GPT 路由下终于可用**。紧急修复也有一条：v3.19.2 在 WSL 路径上已有配置无法更新或切换，受影响用户请直接升级本版。同一批 Windows 修复还包括版本检测大修（五个 issue 一次修）、启动闪屏与 MSI 注册表垃圾键。本版**包含数据库迁移（v16 → v17）**，升级前自动备份，降级需还原备份。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/v3.20.0/docs/release-notes/v3.20.0-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/v3.20.0/docs/release-notes/v3.20.0-ja.md)**

---

## 重点内容：你现在可以

- **用 CC Switch 管理 Pi**：第九个受管应用（[#6064](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/6064)）。供应商表单是针对 Pi 原生 schema 的结构化编辑器，内置 58 个预设与 57 个模型的能力目录；提示词库、`SYSTEM.md` / `APPEND_SYSTEM.md` 编辑器、斜杠命令模板、Skills、会话浏览与安装升级一并接入。Pi 自己的登录、默认供应商与默认模型**永远不被触碰**。首启会导入 `models.json` 里已有的供应商，见[升级提醒](#pi-首次启动会导入既有供应商并回填历史用量)。
- **在看板里看到 Pi 的会话用量**：逐模型的 token、成本、错误与中断轮次，独立的「Pi (Session)」来源与应用筛选；增量同步只解析文件新增部分（[#6463](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/6463)）。
- **添加 Codex 官方供应商时直接选择已授权的 ChatGPT 账号**：认证中心登录任意多个账号，新建官方卡时下拉直选其一完成绑定；也可以照旧添加一张不绑定的空官方卡，跟随 Codex CLI 本地登录、读取本地的 access token。切换到绑定卡会写入该账号完整的令牌包——裸 `codex` CLI 也以该账号运行、且能自行续期。接管下的请求会校验账号一致性，绝不静默把账单记到另一个账号头上（[#3879](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/3879)、[#6535](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/6535)）。
- **在 GPT 路由下使用 Claude Code 的内置 WebSearch**：搜索在上游执行、结果带引用返回、次数进用量；Codex 新客户端的 Alpha Search 端点也不再 404（[#5681](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/5681)）。
- **从 v3.19.2 的 WSL 故障中脱困**：v3.19.2 在 `\\wsl.localhost` 路径上无法更新或切换已有配置（[#6188](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/6188)），该版本内无任何绕过手段——请直接升级本版，并且 CI 从此在真实 WSL2 文件系统上跑测试（[#6233](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/6233)）。
- **让 Windows 版本检测和你的终端看到的一致**：检测改为合并注册表 PATH（用户+机器）、扫描独立安装器目录、优先探测 PATH 默认项——应用内自更新后「未安装」、winget 装的 Claude Code 找不到、旧 npm shim 遮住新版本，五个 issue 一网打尽（[#6284](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/6284)）。
- **给每个模型声明它真实支持的思考档位**：Codex 模型目录支持逐模型多选八
